title: 细胞：生命的基本单位
lead: 一切生物都由细胞构成，细胞膜、细胞质与遗传物质把化学反应区室化为可自我维持、可分裂的最小生命单元。
leadEn: All organisms are made of cells; membrane, cytoplasm and genetic material package chemistry into the smallest self-maintaining, self-dividing unit of life.

points.v: 原核细胞无核膜、体积小；真核细胞有核与膜性细胞器，结构更复杂。
points.vEn: Prokaryotes lack a nucleus and are small; eukaryotes have a nucleus and membrane-bound organelles.

points.v: 细胞膜的选择透过性靠被动扩散与主动转运调控物质进出。
points.vEn: The membrane's selective permeability moves matter by passive diffusion and active transport.

points.v: 线粒体供能、核糖体合成蛋白、溶酶体降解——细胞器各司其职。
points.vEn: Mitochondria supply energy, ribosomes build proteins, lysosomes digest—each organelle has its role.

points.v: 细胞由既有细胞分裂而来，遗传信息随之精确复制并分配。
points.vEn: Cells arise from pre-existing cells, copying and dividing their genetic information faithfully.

sources.label: 《细胞分子生物学》；施莱登与施旺细胞学说
sources.labelEn: Molecular Biology of the Cell; the cell doctrine of Schleiden and Schwann

title: 酶与新陈代谢
lead: 代谢是细胞内所有化学反应的总称，酶作为生物催化剂以高度专一性把反应加速百万倍，让温和条件下的生命成为可能。
leadEn: Metabolism is the sum of a cell's chemistry; enzymes as biocatalysts speed reactions up to a million-fold with high specificity, making life possible under mild conditions.

points.v: 同化作用储能合成分子，异化作用分解释能，两者耦联运转。
points.vEn: Anabolism builds and stores; catabolism breaks down and releases—the two run coupled.

points.v: 酶降低反应活化能，靠活性位点与底物精确契合发挥作用。
points.vEn: Enzymes lower activation energy, acting as active sites fit substrates precisely.

points.v: 温度、pH 与反馈抑制共同调控酶活，维持代谢流的平衡。
points.vEn: Temperature, pH and feedback inhibition tune enzyme activity to steady metabolic flux.

points.v: ATP 是通用的能量载体，在放能与需能反应间转移磷酸基团。
points.vEn: ATP is the universal energy shuttle, transferring phosphate between energy-releasing and -requiring reactions.

title: 光合作用与细胞呼吸
lead: 光合作用把太阳能固定成有机物，细胞呼吸再把有机物氧化释能为 ATP——一存一取，驱动几乎所有生命活动。
leadEn: Photosynthesis fixes sunlight into organic matter; respiration oxidizes it back into ATP—one stores, one releases, powering nearly all life.

points.v: 叶绿素捕获光能，水光解释氧并生成 ATP 与 NADPH。
points.vEn: Chlorophyll traps light; splitting water releases oxygen and makes ATP and NADPH.

points.v: 暗反应以二氧化碳合成糖类，把能量藏进化学键。
points.vEn: The dark reactions build sugars from CO2, storing energy in chemical bonds.

points.v: 糖酵解、三羧酸循环与氧化磷酸化逐步释放能量，绝大多数 ATP 在此生成。
points.vEn: Glycolysis, the Krebs cycle and oxidative phosphorylation release energy stepwise, yielding most ATP.

points.v: 光合与呼吸构成全球碳氧循环的两大支柱，维系大气成分。
points.vEn: Photosynthesis and respiration are the twin pillars of the global carbon–oxygen cycle.

sources.label: 光合与呼吸能量代谢经典研究
sources.labelEn: Classic studies of photosynthetic and respiratory energetics

title: 遗传的孟德尔定律
lead: 性状由离散的遗传因子（基因）决定，它们成对存在、彼此独立、随生殖细胞分离重组——孟德尔由此奠定了遗传学。
leadEn: Traits are set by discrete factors (genes) that come in pairs, segregate and assort independently into gametes—Mendel's foundation of genetics.

points.v: 成对因子在形成配子时彼此分离，各入一个配子。
points.vEn: Paired factors separate when gametes form, each entering one gamete.

points.v: 非同源染色体上的基因在减数分裂中自由组合。
points.vEn: Genes on different chromosomes assort freely during meiosis.

points.v: 杂合子只表现显性性状，隐性在纯合时才显现。
points.vEn: Heterozygotes show the dominant trait; the recessive appears only when homozygous.

points.v: 连锁、不完全显性与多基因现象补充了简单孟德尔比例。
points.vEn: Linkage, incomplete dominance and polygeny extend the simple Mendelian ratios.

title: DNA 与中心法则
lead: 遗传信息以 DNA 碱基序列存储，经转录成 RNA、再翻译成蛋白质而表达——信息流的这一方向就是中心法则。
leadEn: Genetic information is stored in DNA's base sequence and expressed via transcription to RNA and translation to protein—this flow is the central dogma.

points.v: 两条反向平行链以碱基互补配对，既稳定又便于复制与读取。
points.vEn: Two antiparallel strands pair by complementary bases—stable yet easy to copy and read.

points.v: 复制时双链解开，各以旧链为模板合成新链。
points.vEn: During copying the strands unwind, each templating a new partner.

points.v: 基因转录成 mRNA，核糖体按三联密码子装配氨基酸成蛋白质。
points.vEn: Genes are transcribed into mRNA; ribosomes read codons to assemble proteins.

points.v: 碱基改变造成突变，为遗传多样与进化提供原材料。
points.vEn: Base changes cause mutation, the raw material of diversity and evolution.

sources.label: 沃森与克里克 DNA 结构；中心法则
sources.labelEn: Watson and Crick on DNA structure; the central dogma

title: 自然选择与适应
lead: 变异可遗传、资源有限、生存存在差异——满足这些条件，适应环境的性状便代代累积，这就是达尔文的自然选择。
leadEn: Where variation is heritable, resources are limited and survival differs, traits suited to the environment accumulate across generations—Darwin's natural selection.

points.v: 过度繁殖、遗传变异、生存竞争、适者留下——缺一不成选择。
points.vEn: Overproduction, heritable variation, competition and differential survival—selection needs all four.

points.v: 长颈鹿的颈、蛾的拟态都是环境对可遗传变异的定向筛选。
points.vEn: Giraffe necks and moth mimicry are environments directionally sorting heritable variation.

points.v: 性选择、群体选择与亲缘选择补充了单纯的个体适应度。
points.vEn: Sexual, group and kin selection enrich the bare idea of individual fitness.

points.v: 化石序列、同源结构、分子钟与实时观察共同支持演化事实。
points.vEn: Fossil sequences, homologous structures, molecular clocks and live observation all back evolution.

sources.label: 达尔文《物种起源》
sources.labelEn: Darwin, On the Origin of Species

title: 物种形成与多样性
lead: 当种群间的基因交流被地理或生殖屏障切断，各自独立演化终致无法杂交——新的物种便这样诞生，生命之树不断分枝。
leadEn: When gene flow between populations is cut by geographic or reproductive barriers, each evolves on its own until interbreeding fails—new species form and the tree of life branches.

points.v: 地理隔离阻隔交配，生殖隔离（行为、时间、杂交不育）维持物种边界。
points.vEn: Geographic isolation blocks mating; reproductive barriers (behavioral, temporal, hybrid sterility) keep species apart.

points.v: 异地成种最常见，同域与多倍体成种在植物中尤为突出。
points.vEn: Allopatric speciation is commonest; sympatric and polyploid forms stand out in plants.

points.v: 进入空旷生态位后快速分化，如达尔文雀与岛屿类群。
points.vEn: Into open niches lineages diversify fast—Darwin's finches and island faunas.

points.v: 物种会消亡，大灭绝清空生态位，为幸存者开启新的辐射。
points.vEn: Species end; mass extinctions clear niches and open fresh radiations for survivors.

sources.label: 迈尔《物种与进化》成种理论
sources.labelEn: Mayr, Species and Evolution; speciation theory

title: 生态系统的能量与物质
lead: 能量沿食物链单向流动、逐级递减，物质却在生物与非环境之间循环往返——一出一回，撑起整个生态系统。
leadEn: Energy flows one way down food chains and dwindles each step, while matter cycles between living and non-living parts—one passes through, one recirculates.

points.v: 生产者、消费者与分解者构成食物链与更复杂的食物网。
points.vEn: Producers, consumers and decomposers form chains and richer food webs.

points.v: 每级只传递约一成能量，限制了食物链的长度与顶级数量。
points.vEn: Roughly one tenth of energy passes up each level, capping chain length and top predators.

points.v: 碳、氮、水与磷在生物地球化学循环中被反复利用。
points.vEn: Carbon, nitrogen, water and phosphorus are reused through biogeochemical cycles.

points.v: 负反馈与多样性赋予系统抵抗力与恢复力。
points.vEn: Negative feedback and diversity give systems resistance and resilience.

sources.label: 坦斯利生态系统概念与林德曼能量效率
sources.labelEn: Tansley's ecosystem concept; Lindeman's energy efficiency

title: 种群与群落
lead: 同种个体构成种群，异种种群聚合为群落；出生死亡、迁入迁出与种间关系共同刻画它们的数量与格局。
leadEn: Same-species individuals form a population, many populations form a community; births, deaths, migration and species interactions shape their numbers and pattern.

points.v: 年龄结构、性比与增长率决定种群的兴衰与预测。
points.vEn: Age structure, sex ratio and growth rate set a population's rise and forecast.

points.v: 资源限制使增长呈 S 形，种群围绕 K 值波动。
points.vEn: Limits bend growth into an S-curve, oscillating around the carrying capacity K.

points.v: 竞争、捕食、寄生与互利共生编织群落网络。
points.vEn: Competition, predation, parasitism and mutualism weave the community web.

points.v: 从裸地到顶极群落，物种组成随时间有序更替。
points.vEn: From bare ground to climax, composition turns over in an ordered sequence.

sources.label: 种群生态学群落演替经典研究
sources.labelEn: Classic population ecology and succession studies

title: 内环境稳态
lead: 尽管外界波动，机体仍把体温、酸碱、血糖与渗透压维持在一定区间——这种动态稳定是复杂生命的前提。
leadEn: Despite a shifting outside, the body holds temperature, pH, glucose and osmolarity within bands—this dynamic stability underlies complex life.

points.v: 偏离设定值即触发反向调节，如出汗散热、胰岛素降糖。
points.vEn: Deviation from a set-point triggers a corrective response—sweating to cool, insulin to lower sugar.

points.v: 神经快速精准、体液缓慢持久、免疫清除异常，三者协同。
points.vEn: Nerves act fast, hormones slow and long, immunity clears the abnormal—the three coordinate.

points.v: 调节崩溃表现为发热、糖尿与脱水，是许多疾病的共通底色。
points.vEn: Failed regulation shows as fever, glycosuria or dehydration—the common thread of disease.

points.v: 从细胞到生态系统的自我调节，遵循相似的反馈原理。
points.vEn: From cells to ecosystems, self-regulation follows the same feedback logic.

sources.label: 坎农《人体的智慧》稳态理论
sources.labelEn: Cannon, The Wisdom of the Body; homeostasis

title: 免疫防御
lead: 机体以屏障、先天免疫与适应性免疫层层设防，并凭免疫记忆对再犯的病原体反应更快——疫苗正是借力于此。
leadEn: The body defends in layers—barriers, innate and adaptive immunity—and with memory responds faster on re-infection; vaccines harness exactly this.

points.v: 皮肤、黏膜与胃酸阻挡绝大多数入侵，是非特异的前线。
points.vEn: Skin, mucosa and stomach acid block most invaders—an unspecific frontline.

points.v: 吞噬细胞与炎症反应快速泛化应答，不针对特定病原。
points.vEn: Phagocytes and inflammation respond fast and broadly, not targeting a specific pathogen.

points.v: 抗体与 T 细胞精准识别特定抗原，效应强但有潜伏期。
points.vEn: Antibodies and T cells target specific antigens—potent but with a lag.

points.v: 记忆细胞在再遇同种抗原时迅捷扩增，构成疫苗的原理。
points.vEn: Memory cells surge on re-encounter—the very basis of vaccination.

sources.label: 巴斯德免疫与疫苗研究

title: 生物多样性及其价值
lead: 从基因、物种到生态系统的多层多样性，既是演化的成果，也是生态系统稳定与人类福祉的根基。
leadEn: Diversity across genes, species and ecosystems is both the fruit of evolution and the bedrock of ecological stability and human well-being.

points.v: 遗传多样性、物种多样性与生态系统多样性层层嵌套。
points.vEn: Genetic, species and ecosystem diversity nest within one another.

points.v: 提供食物药物、调节气候、维持授粉，兼有潜在与审美价值。
points.vEn: It yields food and medicine, regulates climate, sustains pollination—and holds latent and aesthetic worth.

points.v: 生境破碎、过度开发与气候变化正推高灭绝速率，削弱系统韧性。
points.vEn: Fragmentation, overexploitation and warming raise extinction rates and erode resilience.

points.v: 就地保护、迁地保育与可持续利用并重，守护演化潜力。
points.vEn: In-situ reserves, ex-situ care and sustainable use together safeguard evolutionary potential.

sources.label: EO·威尔逊《生物多样性》
sources.labelEn: E. O. Wilson, The Diversity of Life
